facts.description: Typed facts only: ids, codes, states, amounts, dates, counts. One value per fact, never a sentence.

item.description: The router item this fact grounds, counted from 0.

subject.description: The finding id or record key the fact is about.

field.description: A field name, for example findingId, recordKey, state, conclusionCode, checkCode, statementCode, savedRunId, fileSide, fieldExpression, amount, date, lookalikeCount, controlCount, conflict.

source.description: HUMAN: the person typed it. CONFIG: the audit's settings. TOOL: a record or finding read.

answer.description: For an EXPLAIN or INVESTIGATION_PASTE item: the plain-text answer, citing finding ids, record keys or fields. Otherwise empty.
